span.label: existence
span.quote: We show that the large N limit of certain conformal field theories in various dimensions include in their Hilbert space a sector describing supergravity on the product of Anti-deSitter spacetimes, spheres and other compact manifolds.

span.label: duality between large-N conformal field theories and supergravity on anti-de Sitter spacetimes
span.quote: We conjecture that compactifications of M/string theory on various Anti-deSitter spacetimes is dual to various conformal field theories.

span.label: theoretical-derivation
span.quote: This is shown by taking some branes in the full M/string theory and then taking a low energy limit where the field theory on the brane decouples from the bulk.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the AdS/CFT (holographic) duality: a string/gravity theory in an anti-de Sitter spacetime is equivalent to a conformal field theory living on its lower-dimensional boundary
span.quote: We conjecture that compactifications of M/string theory on various Anti-deSitter spacetimes is dual to various conformal field theories

span.label: the supergravity description is trustworthy only in the large-N limit
span.quote: the supergravity solution can be trusted as long as N is large

span.label: The boundary conditions that the AdS side requires are not specified.
span.quote: We are not going to specify the boundary conditions in AdS, we leave this interesting problem for the future.

span.label: The predictions offered were not checked.
span.quote: However we can make very nontrivial predictions (though we were not able to check them).

span.label: The numerical mismatch between black hole entropy and the perturbative Yang-Mills calculation is unresolved.
span.quote: This is not in disagreement with the correspondence we were suggesting, It is expected that large giV effects change this numerical factor, this problem remains unsolved.

span.label: The lower-supersymmetry cases are treated sketchily and incompletely understood by the author.
span.quote: This part will be more sketchy, since there are several details of the conformal field theories involved which I do not completely understand, most notably the dependence on the various moduli of the compactification.

span.label: A necessary condition of the five-dimensional black string conjecture is left open.
span.quote: It is not clear to me whether this is true.

span.label: The Reissner-Nordstrom section contains an unresolved puzzle.
span.quote: This section is more sketchy and contains an unresolved puzzle, so the reader will not miss much if he skips it.

span.label: The programme as a whole is preliminary.
span.quote: We are only scratching the surface and there are many things to be worked out.

span.label: A published statement by others is flagged as needing caution, with the geometric reason given.
span.quote: However the statement in [49-51] that the AdSs x S3 spacetime is U-dual to the full black hole solution (which is asymptotic to Minkowski space) should be taken with caution

span.label: A distinction the author states is the correct one is then deliberately not made anywhere in the rest of the paper.
span.quote: The representation includes objects in the spinor representations, so we should be talking about SU(4), we will not make this, or similar distinctions in what follows

span.quote: When the effective coupling gN becomes large we cannot trust perturbative calculations in the Yang-Mills theory but we can trust calculations in supergravity
